class.name: BoneClothCollision3D
class.brief_description: A base class of the collisions that interact with [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: A collision works only as a child of [BoneClothSimulator3D], and pushes its chains out. Set [member bone_name] to make the collision follow a bone. Moving or rotating the node then updates the offsets. On a bone, sizes are in meters, as the simulator's values are, and the node's scale is ignored. Without a bone, the node's own transform is used, scale included.

method.name: get_skeleton
method.description: Returns the [Skeleton3D] of the parent [BoneClothSimulator3D], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

members.member: The index of the attached bone. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.
The name of the attached bone.
The index of the mirror bone. [code]-1[/code] is no mirror.

The bone on the other side, such as the right thigh for a collision on the left thigh. The same shape collides there too, mirrored. Set it to [member bone_name] itself to mirror a shape across a center bone such as the hips.
The position offset from the bone, along the bone's axes.
The rotation offset from the bone.
